firstLines: HR specialist with six years supporting 300 to 600 employees in manufacturing and health care. Most of my
work is recruiting, onboarding and employee relations. SHRM-CP.
• Handle full-cycle hiring for about 90 roles a year across two plants; time to fill dropped from 41 days to 27
• Rebuilt onboarding into a two-week plan with checklists for managers; first-90-day turnover fell from 24%
• Investigate and document employee relations cases and advise supervisors on leave, accommodation and
• Moved personnel files and time-off requests into BambooHR for 480 employees
• Scheduled about 60 interviews a week for nursing and caregiver roles and ran Saturday hiring events
• Set up text reminders for candidates, which cut interview no-shows by about a third
• Kept the applicant tracking system clean and sent weekly pipeline reports to hiring managers
Bachelor of Business Administration, Human Resource Management May 2020
• Society for Human Resource Management student chapter, treasurer
HR: Recruiting, onboarding, employee relations, FMLA, ADA
Systems: BambooHR, Workday, Greenhouse, ADP, Excel
